questions.stem: What is the term used for facts, numbers, measures, observations, and other descriptions of things that convey information?
questions.solution: Data refers to facts, numbers, measures, observations, and other descriptions that convey information. Information is the interpretation or meaning derived from data. A graph and a chart are visual representations of data, not the data itself.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a pictograph?
choices: A bar graph with uniform width bars
A graph with pictures representing data
questions.solution: A pictograph is a type of graph that uses pictures to represent data. The correct option describes this definition accurately. A bar graph uses bars, a table with tally marks is a way to count data, and a pie chart uses slices to show proportions, none of which involve pictures to represent data.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक पिक्टोग्राफ का उदाहरण है?
choices: आंकड़ों का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले चित्रों वाला ग्राफ
hi.solution: एक पिक्टोग्राफ एक प्रकार का ग्राफ होता है जो आंकड़ों का प्रतिनिधित्व चित्रों के माध्यम से करता है। सही विकल्प इस परिभाषा को सटीक रूप से व्यक्त करता है। एक बार ग्राफ बार का उपयोग करता है, टैली मार्क्स वाली टेबल आंकड़ों की गणना का एक तरीका है, और एक पाई चार्ट अनुपात दिखाने के लिए टुकड़ों का उपयोग करता है, जिसमें कोई चित्रों का उपयोग आंकड़ों के प्रतिनिधित्व के लिए नहीं किया जाता है।

questions.stem: If 10 students chose hockey as their favorite game, and 8 students chose cricket, which game is more popular?
questions.solution: Hockey is more popular because it was chosen by more students (10) compared to cricket (8). Cricket is less popular since it has a lower number of choices. Both cannot be equally popular because the numbers differ, and there is enough information to determine the more popular game.

hi.stem: यदि 10 छात्रों ने हॉकी अपने पसंदीदा खेल के रूप में चुना, और 8 छात्रों ने क्रिकेट चुना, तो कौन सा खेल अधिक प्रसिद्ध है?
hi.solution: हॉकी अधिक प्रसिद्ध है क्योंकि इसे अधिक छात्रों द्वारा चुना गया (10) क्रिकेट के मुकाबले (8)। क्रिकेट कम प्रसिद्ध है क्योंकि इसके चयन की संख्या कम है। दोनों समान रूप से प्रसिद्ध नहीं हो सकते क्योंकि संख्याएं अलग हैं, और अधिक प्रसिद्ध खेल को निर्धारित करने के लिए पर्याप्त जानकारी है।

questions.stem: If a bar graph uses a scale where 1 unit length represents 4 tickets, how many tickets does a bar of 6 unit lengths represent?
questions.solution: If 1 unit length represents 4 tickets, then 6 unit lengths represent 6 x 4 = 24 tickets. The other options do not match the multiplication. The correct answer is '24 tickets'.

questions.stem: The number of saplings planted on Monday is 10, and on Tuesday it is 15. If the total number of saplings planted on Wednesday and Thursday is 40, what is the total number of saplings planted in the first four days?
questions.solution: The total number of saplings planted on Monday and Tuesday is 10 + 15 = 25. Adding the total on Wednesday and Thursday (40) gives 25 + 40 = 65. The other options do not match the correct calculation.

hi.stem: सोमवार को 10 बीजारोपण किए गए और मंगलवार को 15 बीजारोपण किए गए। यदि बुधवार और गुरुवार को कुल बीजारोपण 40 हैं, तो पहले चार दिनों में कुल बीजारोपण कितने हैं?
hi.solution: सोमवार और मंगलवार को कुल बीजारोपण 10 + 15 = 25 है। बुधवार और गुरुवार के कुल बीजारोपण (40) को जोड़ने से 25 + 40 = 65 प्राप्त होता है। अन्य विकल्प सही गणना के बराबर नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate terminology.

questions.stem: If the cost of education is Rs. 800 and the cost of food is Rs. 3400, is the cost of education less than one-fourth the cost of food?
choices: Only if the cost of food is doubled
questions.solution: To determine if the cost of education is less than one-fourth the cost of food, calculate one-fourth of Rs. 3400, which is Rs. 850. Since Rs. 800 is less than Rs. 850, the answer is 'Yes'. The option 'No' is incorrect because Rs. 800 is indeed less than one-fourth of Rs. 3400. 'Cannot be determined' and 'Only if the cost of food is doubled' are not supported by the given numbers.

questions.stem: In the frequency distribution table of wickets taken by Jaspreet Bumrah, how can the total number of wickets be correctly calculated?
choices: By multiplying the number of matches by the number of wickets
By adding the products of the number of matches and wickets
By counting the number of matches
questions.solution: The correct method involves adding the products of the number of matches and wickets for each category, as this accounts for the total wickets across all matches. Multiplying the number of matches by the number of wickets does not consider varying wicket counts per match. Adding the numbers 0 through 7 or counting the number of matches does not provide the total wickets taken.
